message.content: This editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover with a white and light grey gradient background. At the top, a bold red masthead reads "TEMPO," with smaller text below: "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." The main headline is "GEMOY-GEMOY GASPOL." Two caricatured men stand in the center. To the left is a very stout man with a round head, small features, and a large, protruding belly. He wears a light-colored, short-sleeved button-down shirt and trousers. His hands rest on his hips. To his right stands a much taller, thinner man in a brown uniform with a peaked cap, saluting with his right hand. His eyes are closed, and he has a slight smile. The uniform includes a tall collar, shoulder straps, and multiple pockets. At the bottom left, a vertical barcode and a QR code are visible alongside the text "4-10 DESEMBER 2023" and "RP 50.000." Various Indonesian news headlines and page numbers are positioned at the top and left-center of the composition.
